goal: Port bq-inspect from the google-cloud-tools TypeScript package to a standalone Python PyPI package with CLI parity, tests, and documentation.
summary: Completed a full Python port of bq-inspect: bootstrap and ADR, JSON Schema contracts and validation, hexagonal core/bigquery layers, CLI commands with --params and schema discovery flags, 141 unit/integration tests with fixture client injection, and Phase 4 user/contributor documentation (README, CONTRIBUTING, orchestration plan).

tasks.title: Bootstrap Python repository and ADR
tasks.description: Initialize pyproject.toml, hatchling build, uv/mise toolchain, CLI entrypoint bq_inspect.cli:main, and ADR 0003 documenting the port from TypeScript.

tasks.title: Port schemas, shared types, and core use cases
tasks.description: JSON Schema input/output contracts, validate_input, core jobs/datasets/tables use cases, project_job views, and shared errors/envelopes/IAM hints.

tasks.title: BigQuery transport and CLI command surface
tasks.description: google-cloud-bigquery adapter, ADC/impersonation auth, cli argv/params/input pipeline, commands for jobs/datasets/tables, help/usage, and legacy schema subcommand.

tasks.title: Test suite with fixture client injection
tasks.description: 141 pytest tests across core, schemas, bigquery, and CLI layers using FixtureJobClient and FixtureBigQueryClient; JSON job fixtures; CI workflow on Python 3.10–3.12.

tasks.title: README, CONTRIBUTING, and orchestration plan
tasks.description: Port user docs from TypeScript README (adapted for pip/uv install and Python implementation note), contributor guide with make setup/test/lint and architecture, remove placeholder test_dummy.py, record completed orchestration in .orchestrate/bq-inspect-python/plan.json.
